zones.what: Lifeboats are mounted at Deck 3 level; obstructions affect views from Decks 3 and 4, with Deck 3 facing the boats directly and Deck 4 looking over them.
zones.effect: Ocean view and balcony cabins see lifeboats filling the lower frame when looking down or straight out; horizon remains clear when looking up or forward/aft along the ship.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests who want unobstructed water views for photography or aesthetic reasons; doesn't matter to guests prioritizing price, interior cabins, or those who spend little time on their balcony.

zones.what: Solarium (indoor/outdoor pool area with glass roof) sits on Deck 10 directly above mid and aft sections.
zones.effect: Potential for daytime deck chair movement, occasional splashing sounds, and activity from early morning through late evening in the covered pool area overhead.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers or those seeking quiet during the day; minimal impact for guests out exploring or who tolerate ambient resort noise.

zones.what: Main pool deck, whirlpools, and outdoor activity area on Deck 10 directly above.
zones.effect: Daytime and evening noise from pool activities, deck chairs being moved, music, and foot traffic until late evening.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for light sleepers or anyone in the cabin during peak pool hours; not an issue for guests who are out during the day and sleep soundly.

zones.what: Windjammer Café (buffet venue) on Deck 9 sits above Deck 8 mid-section cabins.
zones.effect: Early morning galley prep noise (from around 6:00 AM), foot traffic, and chair/table movement from breakfast through late evening snacks.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to anyone sensitive to early morning noise or wanting guaranteed quiet in their cabin; less relevant for early risers or those rarely in the cabin.

zones.what: Deck 2 below houses the main theatre (Tropical Theatre) in the forward section.
zones.effect: Evening show noise and vibration transmitted upward, particularly during performances with music and bass, typically until 10:30-11:00 PM.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to guests with early bedtimes or sensitive to vibration; minimal issue for night owls or those attending shows themselves.

zones.what: Deck 3 directly below houses the main theatre (Tropical Theatre) in the forward section.
zones.effect: Evening show noise and vibration one deck removed, less intense than Deck 3 but still noticeable during louder performances.
zones.mattersTo: Minor concern for sensitive sleepers during show times; most guests won't notice or will be at the shows.

zones.what: Main elevator banks run forward and aft on the Radiance class, with stairwells adjacent; mid-ship has limited vertical access.
zones.effect: Cabins near forward and aft elevator/stair areas experience convenient access but mechanical hum and foot traffic 24/7; mid-ship cabins trade longer walks for quieter corridors.
zones.mattersTo: Mobility-limited guests and families with small children benefit from proximity despite noise; guests prioritizing quiet should avoid cabins immediately adjacent to elevator cores.

zones.what: Aft Deck 2 and lower Deck 3 aft sit closest to propulsion machinery.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum, more noticeable at cruising speed and during maneuvering, particularly in the lower aft cabins.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to vibration-sensitive sleepers or those wanting the quietest possible cabin; many guests acclimate quickly or don't notice at all.

zones.what: Bow thruster machinery forward on lower decks operates during docking and departure maneuvers.
zones.effect: Loud mechanical grinding/whirring for 10-30 minutes during port arrivals and departures, typically early morning and late afternoon.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for light sleepers during port-intensive itineraries; minimal impact for sound sleepers or guests who are awake during maneuvering.

zones.what: Anchor chain mechanism at the bow on lower forward decks.
zones.effect: Loud chain rumble when dropping or raising anchor, typically very early morning in tender ports (can be 6:00-7:00 AM).
zones.mattersTo: Critical for light sleepers on tender-port itineraries; not relevant for dock-only itineraries or guests unconcerned with early wake-ups.
